properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-02: twelve served tools that take no arguments ignored any argument they were sent and answered as if it had been read — rmcp gives a parameterless handler the open schema {type: object, properties: {}}
properties.statement: Found while building dec:idea-every-argument-refusal-names-the-tool-and-the-field-path. OBSERVED on 0.77.0 through --call: mirrors with {"project_id": "proj:x"} exited 0 with its ordinary reply. The twelve: claim_report, dimension_drifts, evaluate_allocation, graph_report_markdown, hierarchy_issues, linking_report, manual_work_report, mint_seat, mirrors, repair_report, reviewed_defects, surprising_connections — every one a handler with no Parameters, whose rmcp-generated schema has no additionalProperties, while the other no-argument tools take an empty deny_unknown_fields struct and refuse. A silent drop (AGENTS.md rule 4). FIXED in the same change: arguments::close_empty_schemas closes every parameterless schema once at assembly, so the check refuses the argument naming the tool and the key, and the next such tool is covered too.
